Class FlashInferAttentionKernel

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.attention.FlashInferAttentionKernel
All Implemented Interfaces:
AttentionKernel
public final class FlashInferAttentionKernel extends Object implements AttentionKernel
FlashInfer paged BatchPrefill / BatchDecode backend.

Decode (S==1) uses FlashInfer BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCache (vendored headers). Prefill uses GPU page gather + LibTorch SDPA with the same mask semantics as torch_native.

Ragged contiguous prefill (vision tower) uses BatchPrefillWithRaggedKVCache when supported, otherwise batched SDPA inside the FlashInfer module.

Expects AttentionContext.isPaged() with CSR metadata and a FlashInferWorkspace, or AttentionContext.isRaggedContiguous() with cumulative segment indptr. Query layout [B, H, S, D] for paged; [N, H, D] NHD for ragged.

  • Method Details

    • forward

      public Tensor forward(Tensor query, Tensor key, Tensor value, Tensor mask, AttentionContext ctx)
      Description copied from interface: AttentionKernel
      Runs attention.

      For AttentionBackend.TORCH_NATIVE, query/key/value are contiguous [B,H,S,D] / [B,H,L,D] and mask is optional.

      For AttentionBackend.FLASHINFER, query is [B,H,S,D] (or [B,S,H,D] — see kernel docs); key/value may be null when AttentionContext.isPaged() (KV read from the pool).

      Specified by:
      forward in interface AttentionKernel
      Parameters:
      query - query tensor.
      key - key tensor, or null when paged.
      value - value tensor, or null when paged.
      mask - attention mask, or null.
      ctx - scale / causal / paged metadata.
      Returns:
      attention output matching query layout expected by the caller ([B,H,S,D] for both backends in v1).
